subject: finding.S0-1
statement: A Google Drive folder locator and Drive paths were in shipped src/ files.

subject: finding.P1b
statement: src/ files stated that a named third-party skill is installed in the operator's account.

subject: finding.SEMANTIC-PRIVACY
statement: The publication guard is pattern-based: it passed an account-state disclosure in a PR. Semantic privacy needs human review.

subject: finding.PR20-P2-3
statement: Credential file names (.npmrc, .netrc, token.json) were in the guard rule but untested.

subject: finding.PR20-P2-7
statement: Third-party Actions are pinned by tag, not by commit SHA. A ratchet test blocks new unpinned references.

subject: finding.PR20-P1-4
statement: The publication-guard workflow runs the PR's own copy of the scanner, so a PR can weaken it. Proposed test: run the scanner from the base ref.

subject: finding.PR20-P1-5
statement: The diff scanner reads no EXIF/GPS in added media; tiff, docx and webm are not routed to review.

subject: finding.PR20-P2-2
statement: Base64-encoded and line-split tokens are not detected (UTF-16 is).

subject: finding.PR20-P2-4
statement: No rules for JWTs, Bearer tokens inside JSON, encrypted PEM, PGP blocks or credentials in URLs.

subject: finding.PR20-P1-3
statement: The guard's mutation score was never re-measured in the repository after the CLI tests were rebuilt.

subject: finding.ISS24-SETTINGS
statement: Main ruleset, required checks, squash-only, evidence-branch and tag rulesets, secret scanning and push protection are in place; brain status re-checks them on read.

subject: finding.ISS24-5
statement: No independent reviewer: required approvals is 0 in a single-maintainer repository.

subject: finding.ISS24-11
statement: No recorded proof that a deliberately failing check blocks a merge.

subject: finding.S0-3
statement: The preflight before every push is not enforced; a pre-commit example exists but is not installed or tested.

subject: finding.OWN-A2
statement: Recognised media gets REVIEW without failing CI, but nothing records the human review before merge.

subject: finding.SNAP-1
statement: In-tree docs lag merges (merged PRs still described as open or proposed). Proposed test: a doc-freshness lint for living docs.

subject: finding.SNAP-5
statement: Two AI tools work in parallel and needed one register of current decisions and open work: brain status.

subject: finding.AUTHORITY
statement: Both AI tools commit under the owner's identity, so a commit cannot prove a decision; a decision counts only when its PR was merged by the owner.

subject: finding.ISS1-1
statement: Independent invocation and bounded completion (T1-T7) never ran on a host; now benchmark check C7.

subject: finding.ADR3-3
statement: ADR-0003 (Security Gate) is still PROPOSED and needs an owner decision.

subject: finding.SNAP-7
statement: The relation between this repository and the separate Pilot 01 operations skill is not defined.

subject: finding.SNAP-3
statement: "Pilot 01" named two different things; ADR-0005 D7 renamed the memory scenarios T01-T08.

subject: finding.HISTORY
statement: Removed personal material and a host user name remain in closed-PR history; rewriting history needs a separate owner decision.

subject: finding.PR20-P2-4
statement: Rules added for JWTs, Bearer tokens inside JSON/YAML, encrypted PEM and PGP private keys, and credentials in URLs (placeholders exempt).

subject: finding.PR20-P2-2
statement: Base64 and URL-safe base64 encodings of known tokens are now detected; tokens split across lines are still not.

subject: finding.PR20-P1-5
statement: tiff, webm and Office files (docx, xlsx, pptx) are now routed to review; EXIF/GPS in added media is still read only by the manual history audit.
